summary: End-to-end tested Self-Service Portal ('/dashboard?tab=profile'). Backend 5-endpoint contract (GET /api/me, GET /api/me/summary, PATCH /api/me/profile, POST /api/me/change-password, POST /api/me/inspire) plus avatar-validation + Claude inspire integration — all 9 pytest cases green (100%). Frontend Playwright covered login → tab switch → quote hero (curated rotation + Claude personalisation with 'personalised' pill) → identity strip + streak/founding chips → 4 stat rings (all showing %) → personal-details edit/save with Save-changes → All-saved label reset → avatar upload with data-URI persistence across reload → password change with success toast → new-password login OK. Learning-tab regression preserved (welcome header, founding badge, referral panel, next-best, enrollments strip). No console errors outside pre-existing alerts-center 401 polls.

issues: Confetti burst on avatar-save and password-change fires correctly per code inspection but timing-sensitive to detect in Playwright (2.2s TTL) — visual verification via manual load confirmed vibrant mesh gradient + hand-drawn underline + gold Founding-#N pill render correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: me_router.py — clean, correctly guards Google-auth users, avatar validated for MIME + decoded-size (~400KB cap after base64 decode), no _id leak (excludes in _public_user).
SelfServicePortal.jsx — Promise.all for /me + /me/summary is right pattern. onAvatarUpdated properly re-syncs both profile & summary state + calls refreshUser and fires confetti.
QuoteHero.jsx — good UX: pop animation on quote change, 'personalised' pill only shows after Claude success, curated pool avoids hitting LLM cost by default.
AvatarUploader.jsx — client-side canvas 256x256 JPEG @ q=0.85 is the right compression choice; verified compressed test image (400x400 → data URI) accepted end-to-end and persists across page reload.

Minor: 'ss-quote-shuffle' button could re-roll the same quote 2× in a row (pure random) — the 4-click rotation test still saw 4 unique quotes on this run, but low-probability edge case remains. Not a blocker.

Minor: fireConfetti mutates document.body directly and uses setTimeout — if user navigates away within 2.2s the DOM node lingers on next mount. Not a practical concern given SPA routing keeps body alive.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Self-Service Portal feature is stable. All 5 /api/me/* endpoints pass contract tests. UI regression suite for future iterations should ensure (a) Dashboard.jsx tab switcher continues to sync ?tab=profile URL param, (b) profile.can_change_password branch renders fallback copy for Google users, (c) inspire endpoint gracefully falls back to curated pool when Emergent LLM key is missing/quota-hit. The Claude call takes ~4-15s in preview — always wait ~20s in Playwright after clicking 'Personalise for me'. For Google-user testing (srijit@srijitnair.com), main agent needs to provide fresh cookie/token — this iteration did NOT verify the Google-user fallback UI directly (backend can_change_password logic is proven).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Feature works as specified.
